module_summary: Two-master Wishbone arbiter: a single owner register (priority, alternating or last scheme) muxes master A or B request signals onto the shared bus and routes ack/stall/err back only to the owner.

anchors.name: r_a_owner
anchors.why: Grant register: 1 selects master A, 0 master B for all bus muxes

anchors.name: ALT.last_owner
anchors.why: Alternating-scheme memory of last owner, flips grant when bus idle

anchors.name: i_a_cyc
anchors.why: Master A bus cycle request; held owner while asserted

anchors.name: i_a_stb
anchors.why: Master A strobe; claims bus when B idle

anchors.name: i_b_cyc
anchors.why: Master B bus cycle request

anchors.name: i_b_stb
anchors.why: Master B strobe; claims bus when A idle

anchors.name: i_a_adr
anchors.why: Master A address muxed to o_adr

anchors.name: i_a_dat
anchors.why: Master A write data muxed to o_dat

anchors.name: i_b_adr
anchors.why: Master B address muxed to o_adr

anchors.name: i_b_dat
anchors.why: Master B write data muxed to o_dat

anchors.name: o_cyc
anchors.why: Arbitrated bus cycle from owning master

anchors.name: o_stb
anchors.why: Arbitrated strobe from owning master

anchors.name: o_we
anchors.why: Arbitrated write enable from owning master

anchors.name: o_adr
anchors.why: Arbitrated bus address muxed by r_a_owner

anchors.name: o_dat
anchors.why: Arbitrated write data muxed by r_a_owner

anchors.name: i_ack
anchors.why: Slave ack routed only to the owning master

anchors.name: i_stall
anchors.why: Slave stall routed to owner; non-owner always stalled

anchors.name: i_err
anchors.why: Slave bus error routed to owning master

anchors.name: o_a_ack
anchors.why: Ack to master A gated by ownership

anchors.name: o_a_stall
anchors.why: Stall to master A, forced high when not owner

anchors.name: o_b_ack
anchors.why: Ack to master B gated by ownership

anchors.name: o_b_stall
anchors.why: Stall to master B, forced high when not owner

groups.name: Ownership arbiter
groups.description: Grant register updated by priority/alternating/last scheme from cyc/stb requests

groups.name: Request mux
groups.description: Muxes owning master's cyc/stb/we/adr/dat/sel onto the shared bus

groups.name: Response demux
groups.description: Routes ack/stall/err to owner, stalls the non-owner

groups.name: Master request inputs
groups.description: Bus cycle and strobe requests from masters A and B
